ez-gfx-bindings.description: Public EzGfx C ABI. This file is manually maintained; generated headers and managed bindings are derived from it.

handle.name: EzGfxContext
handle.doc: Opaque packed u64 context handle (slot+1/generation in bits 0-39).

handle.name: EzGfxSurface
handle.doc: Opaque packed u64 surface handle; child bits index the context identity arena and resolve only as Surface.

handle.name: EzGfxShader
handle.doc: Opaque packed u64 shader handle; child bits index the context identity arena and resolve only as Shader.

handle.name: EzGfxIndirectBuffer
handle.doc: Opaque packed u64 indirect-buffer handle; child bits index the context identity arena and resolve only as Indirect.

handle.name: EzGfxStructuredBuffer
handle.doc: Opaque packed u64 structured-buffer handle; child bits index the context identity arena and resolve only as Structured.

handle.name: EzGfxTexture
handle.doc: Opaque packed u64 texture handle; child bits index the context identity arena and resolve only as Texture.

enum.name: EzGfxResult
enum.doc: Result returned by context, surface, shader, buffer, and render operations.

value.name: EzGfxResult_InvalidContext
value.doc: The context is null, stale, or does not own the resource.

value.name: EzGfxResult_NotReady
value.doc: The operation is temporarily unavailable, such as a minimized surface.

enum.name: EzGfxTextureError
enum.doc: Result returned by texture loading and unloading.

value.name: EzGfxTextureError_InvalidContext
value.doc: The context is null, stale, or does not own the resource.

value.name: EzGfxTextureError_InvalidArguments
value.doc: Texture data or description failed validation.

value.name: EzGfxTextureError_UnsupportedFormat
value.doc: No registered decoder supports the source format.

value.name: EzGfxTextureError_OutOfTextureHandles
value.doc: The texture handle table is full.

value.name: EzGfxTextureError_DecodeFailed
value.doc: The image decoder rejected the data.

value.name: EzGfxTextureError_WorkerUnavailable
value.doc: No texture upload worker is available.

value.name: EzGfxTextureError_NotFound
value.doc: The texture handle is not loaded.

struct.name: EzGfxSurfaceDesc
struct.doc: Caller-owned native window used to create a Vulkan surface.

field.name: mip_count
field.doc: Number of mip levels, or zero for decoder defaults.

field.name: max_anisotropy
field.doc: Requested anisotropy; zero uses the default.

struct.name: EzGfxByteBuffer
struct.doc: Pointer-plus-length byte range for ABI consumers.

field.name: data
field.doc: Byte range; nullable only when length is zero.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_abi_version
function.doc: Returns the ABI version implemented by the native library.

returns.doc: ABI version; no context is required.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_context_create
function.doc: Creates a Vulkan context and instance.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a creation error.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_context_wait_idle
function.doc: Waits for all context GPU work to become idle.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or EzGfxResult_InvalidContext.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_context_destroy
function.doc: Destroys a context and all native resources it owns.

param.name: context
param.doc: Context to destroy; null is ignored.

returns.doc: No return value; null handles are ignored.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_surface_create
function.doc: Creates a Vulkan surface for a caller-owned native window.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a validation/native error.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_context_init_device
function.doc: Initializes the context device using a created surface.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a native failure.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_surface_resize
function.doc: Updates a surface extent and recreates its swapchain when needed.

param.name: width
param.doc: New width; zero is valid only with zero height for minimized state.

param.name: height
param.doc: New height; zero is valid only with zero width for minimized state.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok, EzGfxResult_NotReady, or an error.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_surface_get_extent
function.doc: Reads the current framebuffer extent.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_NotReady while minimized.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_surface_resize_pending
function.doc: Reports whether a parent-observed resize is pending.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or an error.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_surface_set_snapshot_cache
function.doc: Enables or disables presented-image snapshot caching.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or EzGfxResult_InvalidArgument.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_surface_destroy
function.doc: Destroys a surface while leaving its parent window untouched.

returns.doc: No return value; null handles are ignored.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_shader_compile
function.doc: Compiles a Slang shader program.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a compile error.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_shader_destroy
function.doc: Destroys a compiled shader.

returns.doc: No return value; null handles are ignored.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_vertex_heap_create
function.doc: Creates a vertex heap in the context vertex manager.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or an error.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_index_heap_create
function.doc: Creates the vertex manager's index heap.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or an error.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_vertex_upload_indices
function.doc: Queues an index upload.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a queueing error.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_vertex_upload
function.doc: Queues a vertex upload into a named heap.

param.name: data
param.doc: Vertex data; its byte length must equal element_count multiplied by element_size.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a queueing error.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_enable_all_decoders
function.doc: Registers every built-in image decoder.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a registration error.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_texture_load
function.doc: Queues an image decode and texture upload.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxTextureError_None or a typed texture error.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_texture_binding_index
function.doc: Resolves a texture handle to its bindless descriptor index.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxTextureError_None or a typed texture error.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_texture_unload
function.doc: Queues a texture for destruction.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxTextureError_None or a typed texture error.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_begin_render
function.doc: Begins a render frame for a surface.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_NotReady for a minimized or unavailable frame.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_acquire_indirect
function.doc: Acquires an indirect draw buffer for the active render.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or EzGfxResult_NotReady.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_indirect_write_draw
function.doc: Writes one indexed indirect draw command.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or EzGfxResult_InvalidArgument.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_indirect_set_draw_count
function.doc: Sets the number of indirect commands to execute.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or EzGfxResult_InvalidArgument.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_indirect_release
function.doc: Releases an indirect buffer wrapper.

returns.doc: No return value; null handles are ignored.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_structured_acquire
function.doc: Acquires a mapped structured buffer for the active render.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or EzGfxResult_NotReady.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_structured_write
function.doc: Copies bytes into a mapped structured buffer.

param.name: data_size
param.doc: Number of bytes; zero is allowed.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or EzGfxResult_InvalidArgument.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_structured_release
function.doc: Releases a structured buffer wrapper.

returns.doc: No return value; null handles are ignored.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_render_add_vertex_pipeline
function.doc: Adds a vertex pipeline to the active render graph.

param.name: binding_count
param.doc: Number of bindings; no more than 16.

param.name: push_constant_size
param.doc: Number of push-constant bytes; no more than 128.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a validation/native error.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_render_add_compute_pipeline
function.doc: Adds a compute pipeline to the active render graph.

param.name: binding_count
param.doc: Number of bindings; no more than 16.

param.name: push_constant_size
param.doc: Number of push-constant bytes; no more than 128.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a validation/native error.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_finish_render
function.doc: Validates, submits, and presents the active render graph.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a render failure.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_screenshot_save
function.doc: Saves the last presented surface image to a UTF-8 path.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a native failure.

function.name: ez_gfx_c_imgui_render_demo
function.doc: Renders the Dear ImGui demo window into the active surface.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok, EzGfxResult_NotReady, or a native failure.
